missions.title: Point Blank: Spread the Signal
missions.where: Point Blank · Eagle Wharf promo lockup
missions.hook: A quiet producer's room under the Wharf. Get the late sets heard before the suits buy the dial. Run flyers and collect street requests for the underground lineup. This is a fictional London radio-war contact, not the broadcaster’s actual address.

objectives.text: Go to Point Blank · Eagle Wharf promo lockup on LDN-HOXTON-WEST and put the word about (Front, medium): one successful roll at the contact.

missions.page: RW-POINT-01 · Point Blank: Spread the Signal
missions.twist: Rival promoters are watching the dial. Each action takes Banana Watch time; try again on a later game day if your roll fails.
missions.gm: These venues and contacts are fictional; real stations are only sources of live audio. Your mission requires the confirmed physical contact on the correct scene.

stops.name: Point Blank · Eagle Wharf promo lockup

locations.name: Point Blank · Eagle Wharf promo lockup

playGuide: Find the Point Blank · Eagle Wharf promo lockup contact marker on LDN-HOXTON-WEST.
Right-click the radio-war contact and choose Work this radio contact. Your character must be on foot, within two squares of it.
In the dialog, pick this job (RW-POINT-01), choose Put the word about (Front, medium) and roll.
A successful verified roll completes the objective; failed attempts can be retried on the next Banana Watch day.
